speaker: Doctor
text: That's a helpful start. Since the rash appeared suddenly alongside a new cough and recent arthritis management, could you describe the specific symptoms in your joints and the nature of the cough? Also, have you noticed any fever or chills recently?

text: My main symptom is Rash on the upper half of the back. I also have Concern over sudden onset, Recent cough, Unaware of exposure to new environmental stimuli, Mucositis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms (DRESS) syndrome. The combination of a sudden rash on the upper back, new onset cough, arthritis symptoms, and mucositis following the start of a new medication for arthritis is highly suggestive of a severe drug hypersensitivity reaction. I recommend stopping the suspected medication immediately and ordering blood work to check for eosinophilia and organ involvement.
